title: Max Fleischer's Superman
description: Superman protects Metropolis and the world from mad scientists, mechanical monsters, natural disasters, saboteurs, and spies in seventeen landmark Technicolor animated adventures.

episodes.title: Superman
episodes.description: A mad scientist threatens Metropolis with a destructive energy ray, forcing Superman to save the city and rescue Lois Lane.

episodes.title: The Mechanical Monsters
episodes.description: Superman battles an inventor's army of flying robots after they steal priceless jewels and carry Lois Lane to their secret base.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Mechanical Monsters (1941; HD) [hHgjbz7dLIM].mp4

episodes.title: Billion Dollar Limited
episodes.description: Armed robbers attack a train carrying a billion dollars in gold, leaving Superman to save its passengers and precious cargo.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： Billion Dollar Limited (1942; HD) [zYXORfbB82k].mp4

episodes.title: The Arctic Giant
episodes.description: A prehistoric monster thaws from Arctic ice and rampages through Metropolis while Superman races to stop it.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Arctic Giant (1942; HD) [VBz2jbx1p80].mp4

episodes.title: The Bulleteers
episodes.description: Criminals in a powerful bullet-shaped rocket terrorize Metropolis until Superman takes on their seemingly unstoppable machine.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Bulleteers (1942; HD) [U2QChU-xcqI].mp4

episodes.title: The Magnetic Telescope
episodes.description: An astronomer's magnetic telescope pulls a comet toward Earth, and Superman must prevent a worldwide catastrophe.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Magnetic Telescope (1942; HD) [M68DUylHGOY].mp4

episodes.title: Electric Earthquake
episodes.description: A scientist attacks Manhattan with electrically generated earthquakes, putting Lois in danger and forcing Superman underground.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Electric Earthquake (1942; HD) [G4RsSUUIOCc].mp4

episodes.title: Volcano
episodes.description: A volcanic eruption traps Lois and threatens a nearby community, leaving Superman to battle fire, lava, and collapsing rock.

episodes.title: Terror on the Midway
episodes.description: An escaped circus gorilla causes panic on the midway and captures Lois, prompting a rescue by Superman.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： Terror on the Midway (1942; HD) [-W89hfqKFuE].mp4

episodes.title: Japoteurs
episodes.description: Superman confronts wartime saboteurs who hijack and attempt to destroy a newly built bomber aircraft.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.description: A criminal disguised as Superman commits a string of robberies, and the real Man of Steel must clear his name.

episodes.title: Eleventh Hour
episodes.description: While imprisoned in wartime Japan, Superman conducts nightly sabotage raids and tries to protect Lois from retaliation.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： Eleventh Hour (1942; HD) [dAtIcyLFb2g].mp4

episodes.title: Destruction, Inc.
episodes.description: Lois investigates sabotage at a munitions plant and uncovers a plot that only Superman can stop.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： Destruction Inc. (1943; HD) [TpGc0YEJ7b4].mp4

episodes.title: The Mummy Strikes
episodes.description: Superman investigates a murder mystery involving an Egyptian museum exhibit and a seemingly living mummy.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Mummy Strikes (1943; HD) [8amNSC35RH4].mp4

episodes.title: Jungle Drums
episodes.description: Lois discovers a hidden wartime base in the African jungle, and Superman races to prevent an enemy attack.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： Jungle Drums (1943; HD) [T1tF4cq1F9A].mp4

episodes.title: The Underground World
episodes.description: An expedition into deep caverns encounters a hidden civilization of hawk-men, leaving Superman to rescue the explorers.
episodes.file: Max Fleischer's Superman： The Underground World (1943; HD) [MG16mBwJIAI].mp4

episodes.title: Secret Agent
episodes.description: Superman protects a secret agent carrying a list of enemy spies while saboteurs pursue her across the city.
